body.name: Vacuous-denominator bow baseline
body.construction: On \(\mathcal D_{\mathrm{iso}}\), set \(P(U_b=1)=P(C_b=1)=1/2\), \(P(X_b=1\mid U_b=0)=1/4\), \(P(X_b=1\mid U_b=1)=3/4\), \(P_{\sigma}(Y_b=1\mid X_b=a,U_b=u)=1/2+\sigma(u-r^b_a)/4\), \(P(S_b=1\mid Y_b=0)=1/3\), and \(P(S_b=1\mid Y_b=1)=2/3\). The models \(\mathbf M_{\mathrm{iso},+}\) and \(\mathbf M_{\mathrm{iso},-}\) use the two signs.
